subject.title: fix(ui): reject nondecimal strings in config form number coercion

question: Should generic Control UI number fields continue accepting scientific notation such as `1e3`, or should OpenClaw intentionally narrow all form-number input to plain decimal spelling?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes an existing user input contract, and the closest merged precedents differ by domain: cron intentionally uses a stricter grammar while fleet retains scientific numeric input.

options.title: Preserve scientific notation
options.body: Accept decimal scientific notation in generic config number coercion while continuing to reject hexadecimal, binary, octal, and leading-plus spellings.

options.title: Adopt plain-decimal-only forms
options.body: Keep the proposed grammar, but explicitly accept the compatibility break and add release-facing documentation and upgrade evidence for existing Control UI users.

recommendation.title: Preserve scientific notation
recommendation.body: Accept decimal scientific notation in generic config number coercion while continuing to reject hexadecimal, binary, octal, and leading-plus spellings.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged Control UI numeric-validation work is the closest related decision surface.
